$comment: Fixed condition list for reporting.conditions (A11). Approved v0.1 by the Biomedical lead (Shawn), 2026-10-31.

rules: keep study-design headings (Disease Models, Animal D004195; Prenatal Exposure Delayed Effects D011297)

broad parent terms only: mechanical reduction drops a descriptor only if EVERY one of its tree numbers has an ancestor tree number owned by a descriptor that stays on the list (fixpoint); any uncovered tree number keeps it; the two study-design headings are always kept

filter_expansion: Each entry matches itself and every narrower MeSH descriptor whose tree number falls under one of the entry's tree_numbers (MeSH 2026 tree).

entry_terms: MeSH entry-term synonyms (up to 5, from candidate)
Neurogenic Dysfunction of the Urinary Bladder
Familial Third and Fourth Pharyngeal Pouch Syndrome
Tic Disorder, Combined Vocal and Multiple Motor
Congenital Fissure of the Abdominal Cavity
Corpus Callosum, Agenesis Of, With Chorioretinal Abnormality
Agenesis of Corpus Callosum with Infantile Spasms and Ocular Abnormalities

entries.preferred_term: Drug-Related Side Effects and Adverse Reactions
entry_terms: Drug Related Side Effects and Adverse Reactions
Drug-Related Side Effects and Adverse Reaction
Drug Related Side Effects and Adverse Reaction

rollup_lookup: schemas/condition_rollup.json maps every dropped candidate descriptor + tree number to the approved parent covering it.
